name: Two edges at once
engine: Yamal's run and Olmo's free man both count, so play them in that order.
about: One rule exception makes two specialists complementary. Normally only the biggest edge counts. Yamal's won run stretches their defence for the rest of the attack (+2 on every later pass or shot); Olmo finds the free man at the edge of their box (the man he finds is unmarked, +2). Apart, those two edges compete and only one counts; with Two edges at once they add up, so the order is: Yamal runs, Olmo finds the free man, then the shot. On defence Cucurella and Porro show their man wide instead of tackling (+2 to your next stop), and in your box that edge adds to any other your defence carries.
